items.title: Torrent Power's Q2 net profit rises 13% YoY to Rs 838 crore
items.description: In a strong financial report, Torrent Power recorded a 13% increase in net profit, totaling ₹838 crore for the latest September quarter. Revenue surged by 24.5% to ₹9,802 crore, up from ₹7,876 crore the previous year. Although Ebitda grew by 15.5% to ₹1,739 crore, tighter Ebitda margins reflect the pressure of increased finance costs.

items.title: Kansai Nerolac Q2 net profit rises 8% YoY to Rs 144 crore
items.description: Kansai Nerolac Paints announced an 8% increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company reported a revenue rise of over 18% to reach ₹2,317.48 crore. This growth was driven by strong performance in both decorative and industrial segments. The company addressed challenges related to raw material prices and foreign exchange through pricing and cost management efforts.

items.title: Zydus Lifesciences Q2 net profit falls 26.6% to Rs 925.5 crore
items.description: Zydus Lifesciences reported a net profit of ₹925.5 crore for the September quarter, which declined by 26.6%. The company's revenue from operations increased by 29.2% to ₹7,909.6 crore during the same period. Total expenses rose significantly to ₹6,806.6 crore, impacting profitability. The pharmaceuticals business contributed 83% to overall sales, with revenue from India formulations at ₹1,884.4 crore. North America formulations reported revenue of ₹3,314.5 crore, highlighting strong global performance.

items.title: Niva Bupa Q2 YoY profit after tax soars 124%
items.description: Niva Bupa Health Insurance reported an impressive 124% year-on-year profit surge in the second quarter, leading to a profit after tax of ₹136 crore, up from ₹60 crore last year. The gross written premium also saw a substantial growth of 35%, totaling ₹2,484 crore this quarter. Notably, retail health premiums soared by 47% to ₹1,876 crore, while the company's expense ratio improved to 36.4% for the first half.

items.title: ENIL's Q2 Ebitda rises 9.5% on cost cuts, lower digital losses
items.description: Entertainment Network India Ltd has reported a 9.5% increase in Ebitda and a consolidated revenue of ₹117 crore. Radio contributed a significant 53% of the domestic revenue during the quarter. The digital revenue grew while the Ebitda loss for the digital sector narrowed compared to the previous year. Chief executive Yatish Mehrishi indicated efforts to reshape the company for improved profitability and new growth avenues.

items.title: PhysicsWallah Q2 net profit doubles to Rs 144 crore, revenue rises 18%
items.description: PhysicsWallah, an Edtech company, achieved a considerable increase in net profit for the September quarter. The consolidated net profit rose to ₹143.63 crore, more than double the amount from last year. Revenue from operations also experienced an 18% increase, reaching ₹1,242.26 crore compared to the previous year. The company benefitted from stronger online enrolments and improved cost efficiency amid a slowdown in medical coaching.

items.title: Digital brands, premium FMCG to drive ITC's growth ambitions
items.description: Amid challenges in its cigarettes business, ITC is focusing on expanding its non-cigarette offerings. The FMCG segment has shown significant growth, leading to an improved product mix and margins. Digital-first brands such as Yoga Bar and Prasuma have also reported strong revenue increases. The paperboard and agri businesses are benefiting from rising demand and exports of value-added products.

items.title: EPL Q2 Results: Profit rises 4% YoY to Rs 111 crore
items.description: EPL reported a notable 4.52% increase in net profit, reaching Rs 110.9 crore for the September quarter of FY27. With revenues from operations climbing to Rs 1,567.4 crore, a 30% year-on-year growth, the Beauty & Cosmetics and Oral Care segments played pivotal roles. Despite higher expenses, the EBITDA margins held strong above 20%. Looking forward, EPL is set to focus on sustained revenue growth and stable profit margins.

items.title: M&M Q2 Results: Profit rises 25% YoY to Rs 4,588 crore, revenue grows 25%
items.description: M&M Q2 Results: Revenue from operations grew 25.4% YoY to Rs 57,514.98 crore in Q2FY27, against Rs 45,885.40 crore reported in the year-ago period.

items.title: LG Electronics India Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 27% YoY to Rs 489 crore; stock climbs 5%
items.description: LG Electronics India reported a net profit of Rs 489 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which is an increase. The profit jumped 27% year-on-year compared to Rs 389 crore from the same period last year. Revenue from operations totaled Rs 7,380 crore, showing a rise of 19.5% from Rs 6,174 crore previously. Following the earnings release, shares of LG India surged nearly 5% on the BSE exchange.

items.title: Paras Healthcare posts Rs 40 crore Q2 net profit in first results after listing
items.description: Paras Healthcare announced a profit after tax of Rs 40.35 crore in the September quarter. This performance shows a significant increase from the net profit of Rs 12.38 crore reported last year. Revenue from operations reached Rs 510.89 crore, with expenses at Rs 463.12 crore during the same period. The company utilized a portion of its IPO proceeds to strengthen its balance sheet.

items.title: Godfrey Phillips Q2 profit down 37% to Rs 190 cr; revenue up twofold at Rs 4,198 cr
items.description: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd reported a significant 37.73 percent decrease in net profit for the September quarter, primarily driven by a substantial tax increase from the previous fiscal year. Despite this, the company's total consolidated income surged to Rs 8,139.64 crore during the first half of FY27. To counteract the volumetric impact from rising taxes, a tactical pricing strategy was implemented.

items.title: Glenmark Pharma Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 56% to Rs 264 crore, revenue down at Rs 4,247 cr
items.description: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals experienced a 56.78 percent drop in consolidated profit after tax during the September quarter. Total revenue from operations decreased to Rs 4,247.32 crore compared to the previous year. The company's total expenses also decreased during the same period, indicating some operational efficiency. A subsidiary of Glenmark Pharma entered into a settlement for USD 15 million with Humana Inc.

items.title: ONGC Q2 Results: Consolidated PAT jumps 47% YoY to Rs 18,535 crore; co declares interim dividend Rs 8/share
items.description: ONGC reported a 46.9% YoY rise in consolidated Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 18,534.82 crore, while revenue grew 25.6%. The company declared an Rs 8 interim dividend and approved a Rs 10,000 crore loan to ONGC Videsh.

items.title: Britannia Industries Q2 Results: Profit rises 11% YoY to Rs 726 crore, revenue grows 16%
items.description: Britannia Q2 Results: FMCG major Britannia Industries on Thursday reported a 10.8% year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 726 crore for the September quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 655.06 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal.

items.title: Gaja Alternatives net profit up 128% at Rs. 64.7 crore
items.description: Gaja Alternatives reported a 128% sequential rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs. 64.7 crore, with revenue increasing 26% to Rs. 65.5 crore. The private equity asset manager highlighted strong fund performance, zero debt and expanding investments.

items.title: LIC Q2 Results: Profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 12,115 crore, NPI grows 16%
items.description: LIC Q2 Results: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), the country's largest insurer, reported a nearly 20% rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 12,114.78 crore for the September quarter on Thursday, supported by strong growth in premium income and higher investment earnings.

items.title: Titan Q2 Results: Profit jumps 54% YoY to Rs 1,722 crore; total income up 25%
items.description: Titan Q2 Results: Titan Company reported a 54% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,722 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by strong demand across jewellery, watches and eyewear. Revenue growth remained broad-based despite a shift in the festive calendar, while international jewellery operations expanded with the addition of Damas..

items.title: Bharti Airtel Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 31% YoY to Rs 8,887 crore; revenue up 17%; ARPU rises to Rs 271
items.description: Bharti Airtel Q2 Results: Bharti Airtel reported a 31% year-on-year (YoY) increase in net profit to Rs 8,887.5 crore for the September quarter (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 6,791.6 crore in the corresponding quarter last fiscal.
